# GOLDAGRO Global Export

> Merchant exporter based in Thane (Mira Road East), Maharashtra, India. Two divisions: (1) Indian spices, fresh fruits and vegetables, (2) imitation jewellery. Sells to international B2B buyers in container / bulk quantities. Website: https://goldagroglobalexport.com

- Port of loading: Nhava Sheva (JNPT), Mumbai
- Incoterms: FOB Mumbai (JNPT), CIF to major ports (Incoterms 2020)
- Payment terms: T/T (advance + balance against documents) or L/C at sight
- Minimum order: usually one 20ft container; smaller trial orders may be possible
- Samples: available by courier; buyer pays courier charges
- Documents: commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, certificate of origin; phytosanitary certificate per agro shipment; lab reports on request

## Agro division (https://goldagroglobalexport.com/)
- Spices: dry red chilli (Guntur/Teja), red chilli powder, green cardamom, nutmeg and mace, sesame seeds
- Vegetables: Nashik red onions, spinach, lemons, green peas, sweet corn
- Fruits: mosambi (sweet lime), G-9 Cavendish bananas, oranges, pineapple, apples
- Specifications, grades, packing and availability are confirmed per lot before order.

## Jewellery division (https://goldagroglobalexport.com/jewellery)
- Imitation (fashion) jewellery: necklaces, bridal sets, bangles, earrings; bulk and custom designs. Not gold or silver.
